title: Clavo Cellars

blurb: Guests visit the Templeton tasting room to enjoy a range of handcrafted wines in a laid-back atmosphere, either inside or on the shaded patio. The winery focuses on sustainable vineyard practices and terroir-driven wines from Paso Robles and Edna Valley AVAs. They offer a wine club with shipments of 3, 6, or 12 bottles every three months, including exclusive events and discounts.
